Installation Guide

Prerequisites

Before running the application, make sure the following software is installed:

  • Python 3.13

  • MySQL Server

  • MySQL client or MySQL Workbench

  • Visual Studio Code or another code editor

Download the Project

Open the project folder in your terminal.

Install Required Packages

Create a virtual environment:

python -m venv venv

Activate the virtual environment on Windows:

venv\Scripts\activate

Install the required Python packages:

python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn pymysql bcrypt python-dotenv itsdangerous

Database Configuration

Make sure MySQL Server is running.

Create the database and configure the database connection according to the settings used by the application’s database module.

Environment Configuration

Configure the required environment variables, such as database credentials and session secret, according to the project’s configuration.

Run the Application

Start the FastAPI application using:

python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

Open the following URL in your browser:

http://127.0.0.1:8000

API Documentation

FastAPI provides interactive API documentation at:

http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs
